test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

“You were warned by us three days ago,” the manager shouted at him.

options.text: The manager shouted at him that he was warned by them three days earlier.
The manager shouted at him that he had been warned by them three days before.
The manager shouted at him that he was warned by them three days before.
The manager shouted at him that he was warned by them three days ago.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The manager shouted at him that he had been warned by them three days before.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"You were warned by us" becomes "he had been warned by them"**
 
 
• Pronoun "You" is changed to "he" to match indirect speech.
 
• Verb "were warned" is converted to "had been warned" to match past perfect tense in indirect speech.
 
• Pronoun "us" is changed to "them" to match indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **"three days ago" becomes "three days before"**
 
 
• Time expression "three days ago" is converted to "three days before" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Indirect speech does not use quotation marks.
 
• The reporting clause "The manager shouted at him" is followed by the conjunction "that".
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The manager shouted at him that he had been warned by them three days before."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The manager shouted at him that he was warned by them three days earlier."

 
 
• The verb form "was warned" does not accurately reflect the past perfect tense required in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The manager shouted at him that he was warned by them three days before."
 
 
• The verb form "was warned" does not accurately reflect the past perfect tense required in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The manager shouted at him that he was warned by them three days ago."
 
 
• Time expression "three days ago" should be converted to "three days before" in indirect speech.
